The '''Star Pond''' was located on the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. It is near the [[meditation pavilion]] where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] summoned the entire [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] for the [[Conclave on Ossus|Jedi Convocation]].<ref name="sw">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
